verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents a quickstart that walks through a minimal end-to-end sandbox payment using Airwallex.js and the hosted payment page. It is backed by self-serve sandbox signup and a pre-built hosted page needing only a single integration. However, the evidence shows no multi-language copy-paste code samples or SDKs, and nothing corroborates the under-a-day time-to-integrate claim. Missing for 10: documented copy-paste examples across server languages/SDKs, independent or hands-on evidence of integration in under a day.

support.subject: As a developer, I can integrate a working payment flow from the docs alone in under a day, with copy-paste examples in my language

citations.quote: Complete a minimal end-to-end online payment in the sandbox environment using Airwallex.js and Airwallex-hosted payment page.
Airwallex provides a sandbox environment, completely separate from the production environment, for testing your integration through simulations without using real money.
Hosted Payment Page is a secure, pre-built payment page hosted by Airwallex that lets you accept multiple payment methods with a single integration.
